dict.string: TreeletHub needs access to your local network to find and connect to your Mac on the same Wi‑Fi, sync the app grid, and launch apps.
TreeletHub uses the microphone for push-to-talk: your speech is transcribed on this iPhone and the text is typed into ChatGPT, Codex, or Cursor on your Mac.
TreeletHub converts your speech to text on this iPhone so push-to-talk can send prompts to your Mac.
